sections.content:
Bloom (YC S21) unlocks access for a new generation of Americans (ages 13 - 17) to start building wealth early through investing in the stock market. We believe that wealth inequality is one of America's most pressing issues, and that encouraging the next generation to build wealth early is the most effective way to tackle it.
We are incredibly excited to have the opportunity to make a generational impact in improving the financial future of the next generation. Our company is mission-driven, and we've raised $3.3M with backing from some of the best investors in the valley.

sections.heading: What would you be doing?
sections.content:
Architect and build our core React Native product
Create infrastructure and internal tooling to handle extremely high trade transaction volume
Help assess and recruit future engineers

sections.heading: What are we looking for?
sections.content:
2+ years of software engineering experience
Familiarity with Node, TypeScript, & React
Experience with Docker, Storybook, Lerna, and Kubernetes
Bonus: Interest in consumer fintech, and developer tools

sections.heading: Why work with us?
sections.content:
Our stack is modern: on the engineering side, we're Typescript heavy and on the organization side, we're power users of tools like Linear, Figma, Discord. We also have a fervent user community that loves the product.
We have an incredible team backed by the best investors, and we have a kind and fun environment to work in. Our company culture is primarily an engineering culture, and we value technical decisions.
We are providing access for the next generation of Americans to start building wealth on their own initiative
We provide meaningful ownership of work through generous equity and competitive salaries with benefits.
